newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Horton Media buys NZ's Northland Times - NZPA.
newsitem.headline: Horton Media buys NZ's Northland Times - NZPA.

text.p: The Northland Times and Times Print, based in Dargaville, New Zealand, has been sold to Horton Media Ltd, the New Zealand Press Association reported on Wednesday.
The Northland Times would continue its "proud tradition under its new owners who look forward to their association with the district", Horton Media chairman Michael Horton said.
"The daily newspaper has played an important role for generations of Kaipara readers and Horton Media values that heritage."
Times manager Robert Maxted said after Tuesday's signing that he felt the future of the newspaper was secure in the hands of Horton and his people.
"The business exists to serve the community and the only reason it has survived for so many years is because the community wishes its continuance," he said.
